eva (PM): quick sync — we need to finalize launch criteria for the tenant isolation + multi-region routing initiative. customers keep asking for predictable blast radius and per-tenant SLAs :eyes:
carla (Arch): agree. thinking of 3 isolation tiers: shared, bounded-shared, fully-dedicated. each has routing + capacity semantics, plus cost delta.
darren (SRE): we also need clear failure modes & fallback policies. what happens to bounded tenants on region outage? automatic cross-region failover?
ben (Product): priority is customers asking for per-tenant latency SLOs and 'no noisy neighbor' guarantees. they prefer soft isolation first (bounded-shared) then dedicated later.
alice (Eng): from runtime side: bounded-shared requires request tagging + tokenized KV cache partitioning. estimated infra work ~3 sprints to ship core routing + cache isolation.
eva (PM): launch criteria proposal: (1) routing policy primitives (route by tenant, region, tier), (2) canary fallback behavior defined, (3) perf regression <5% p95 for bounded-shared relative to shared, (4) migration rollback plan + cutover playbook. thoughts?
carla (Arch): add: telemetry surfaces per-tenant QPS, tail-latency, cost-per-token. these are gating signals for canary. also need admin knob to quarantine a tenant slice.
darren (SRE): agree. SRE gating: runbook validated, automated quarantine works end-to-end in staging, chaos test: region failover with 1k tenants.
alice (Eng): technical note: we should implement tag-based routing header X-Tenant-ID and a routing table that prefers local region then fallback per policy. sample config: ```routes: - match: tenant: /^acct-/ prefer: region: eu-west-1 fallback: cross-region: true```
ben (Product): customers will want migration options: opt-in test window (5%), traffic split controls, and a pricing uplift for dedicated. We should capture those in the roadmap.
eva (PM): timeline ask: MVP bounded-shared + routing primitives in Q3, dedicated lanes gated to Q4. does that align with engineering capacity?
alice (Eng): Q3 MVP looks tight but doable if we limit scope: no cross-region warm cache — start with cold start fallback and async rewarm. that cuts ~2 weeks of work.
carla (Arch): tradeoff note: starting cold on failover will increase p99 for a short window. need to document SLA delta and present to customers.
darren (SRE): mitigation: short-lived warm pool for critical tenants. add to backlog as performance optimization post-MVP.
ben (Product): can we make launch commit dependent on two customers running bounded-shared in staging for >48h? that's a strong signal.
eva (PM): sounds reasonable. final checklist to sign-off: routing primitives merged, staging run w/ 2 pilot customers, runbook + chaos tests green, dashboards with tenant metrics, rollback tested. assign owners?
carla (Arch): I'll own routing primitives + policy schema.
alice (Eng): I'll own tagging + KV partitioning changes.
darren (SRE): I'll own runbook + chaos tests.
ben (Product): i'll coordinate pilot customers and pricing language.
eva (PM): great — i'll collate and update the initiative doc. deploy-bot: can you note an upcoming canary window?
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-window requested by eva (PM) — window candidate: 2026-05-12 -> 2026-05-14. automated checks include perf, error-rate, and telemetry export. :rocket:
carla (Arch): one more ask — document expected cost delta for bounded-shared vs shared (approx +10–25% depending on load pattern). we'll need that for sales.
eva (PM): noted. i'll add cost delta and customer-facing SLA table to the PRD. thanks all — will post updated doc by EOD with action items. :thumbsup:
